title: jó → jobb, jól → jobban: An Irregular Comparative

sections.title: The exception to -bb
sections.content: You already form comparatives with -bb: meleg → melegebb, egészséges → egészségesebb. jó ("good") breaks the pattern — its comparative is jobb, not "jóbb". Its adverb jól ("well") has its own irregular comparative too: jobban ("better"), the word behind Ma már jobban vagyok ("Today I already feel better"), which you've heard before without the grammar behind it.

items.spanish: A gyümölcs egészségesebb, mint a csoki.
Ha eleget alszom, sokkal jobban vagyok.
items.english: If I sleep enough, I feel much better.

items.spanish: A séta jobb, mint a semmi.
items.english: A walk is better than nothing.

sections.content: Keep jobb (describing a thing: "a better habit") and jobban (describing how you feel or do something: "I feel better") apart the same way you already keep jó and jól apart — one's an adjective, the other an adverb.
